newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ste. Genevieve County. Mo..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ste. Genevieve County. Mo..

text.p: (TO BE ISSUED UNDER THE MISSOURI DIRECT DEPOSIT PROGRAM)
Sealed proposals will be received until 7:00 P. M., CDST,

in the Board of Education Room, 375 North Fifth Street, Ste. Genevieve, Missouri, 63670-1249, at which time said bids will be opened publicly for the purchase, at not less than par and accrued interest, of the above Bonds of said District. The Bonds are to bear date of July 1, 1997, to be of the denomination of $5,000 each or any whole multiple thereof (to be designated by the holder or holders), and to bear interest not exceeding 14% per annum, payable September 1, 1997, and semi-annually thereafter on March 1 and September 1 in each year. The Bonds shall mature serially
on March 1 in each of the years 1998 to 2017, inclusive, in the amounts as set forth in the unabridged Notice of Bond Sale. The 2008 to 2017, inclusive, maturities will be

callable at par and accrued interest on March 1, 2007, or on any interest payment date thereafter. The Bonds will be designated by the Board of Education as qualified tax-exempt obligations'' under the provisions of Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. The District will furnish the Bonds, subject to the unqualified approval of the legality thereof by Messrs. Charles and Trauernicht, St. Louis, Missouri. All bids must be made on the official bidding form, copies of which, along with the Notice of Bond Sale, may be obtained from Mr. Mikel A. Stewart, Superintendent of Schools, 375 North Fifth Street, Ste. Genevieve, Missouri 63670-1249 (Telephone:
573 883-5720) or the Financial Advisor, Mr. David A.
Pickerill, Provident Capital Resources Corporation, 12025 Manchester Road, Suite 60-G, St. Louis, MO 63131-4420
